description: Implement the Three.js render pipeline with post-processing, the modular shader system, the GPU particle engine, and the cinematic camera system. This forms the visual rendering backbone of the application.
steps: Create src/render-engine/types.ts - RenderConfig, PostProcessingConfig, ShaderUniform types

Create src/render-engine/RenderPipeline.ts - main rendering class wrapping Three.js WebGLRenderer. Initialize with canvas element, manage render loop with requestAnimationFrame, support adaptive quality (reduce resolution under load). Expose: render(scene, camera), resize(), setQuality(), getStats()

Create src/render-engine/PostProcessingStack.ts - composable post-processing using Three.js EffectComposer. Support ordered chain of: UnrealBloomPass, custom ChromaticAberrationPass, custom MotionBlurPass, custom DepthOfFieldPass, custom VignettePass, custom FilmGrainPass, custom ColorGradingPass, custom GlowPass. Each effect toggleable and configurable

Create src/render-engine/PerformanceMonitor.ts - track FPS, frame time, GPU memory (if available via WebGL extensions), draw calls, triangles. Implement adaptive quality: if FPS drops below target, reduce resolution scale or disable expensive effects
Create src/render-engine/index.ts exporting public API

Create src/shaders/ShaderManager.ts - load and cache GLSL shaders, support hot reload in dev, compile and link programs, manage uniform updates. Provide audio-reactive uniforms automatically (u_bass, u_energy, u_time, u_beat, u_spectrum)
Create src/shaders/ShaderPresets.ts - registry of built-in shader configurations with names, descriptions, and default parameters
Create src/shaders/post-processing/bloom.frag.glsl - custom bloom fragment shader
Create src/shaders/post-processing/chromatic-aberration.frag.glsl - RGB channel offset based on audio energy
Create src/shaders/post-processing/vignette.frag.glsl - configurable vignette with audio reactivity
Create src/shaders/post-processing/film-grain.frag.glsl - animated film grain noise
Create src/shaders/post-processing/color-grading.frag.glsl - LUT-style color grading
Create src/shaders/post-processing/distortion.frag.glsl - wave distortion reactive to bass
Create src/shaders/vertex/displacement.vert.glsl - audio reactive vertex displacement
Create src/shaders/fragment/raymarching.frag.glsl - basic raymarching SDF template
Create src/shaders/fragment/energy-field.frag.glsl - energy field visualization
Create src/shaders/index.ts exporting shader system
Create src/particles/types.ts - ParticleConfig, ParticleSystem interface

Create src/particles/GPUParticleSystem.ts - GPU accelerated particle system using Three.js Points with BufferGeometry and custom shaders. Support 100k+ particles via instanced rendering. Properties: position, velocity, color, size, life. Physics: gravity, turbulence (simplex noise), vortex, attraction points. Audio reactivity: spawn rate linked to beats, color linked to frequency, size linked to energy, velocity linked to bass
Create src/particles/ParticleEmitter.ts - configurable emitter shapes (point, sphere, ring, plane, custom). Control spawn rate, initial velocity, spread, lifetime
Create src/particles/particle.vert.glsl - vertex shader for GPU particles with size attenuation and life-based alpha
Create src/particles/particle.frag.glsl - fragment shader for particles with soft circle rendering and color
Create src/particles/index.ts exporting particle system

Create src/camera/CameraSystem.ts - cinematic camera controller. Modes: orbit (auto-rotate around target), static, follow, cinematic (predefined paths). Features: smooth interpolation (lerp/slerp), bass shake (translate camera on beat), auto-zoom (pull back on energy), smooth transitions between modes using easing functions
Create src/camera/CameraPresets.ts - predefined camera configurations (close-up, wide, overhead, dramatic-angle, first-person)
Create src/camera/index.ts exporting camera system
Create src/render-engine/__tests__/PerformanceMonitor.test.ts - test adaptive quality logic
Create src/particles/__tests__/ParticleEmitter.test.ts - test emitter configuration and spawn logic
acceptance_criteria: RenderPipeline initializes Three.js renderer with proper configuration
ShaderManager loads GLSL files and provides audio-reactive uniforms
GPUParticleSystem creates BufferGeometry with particle attributes for 100k particles
CameraSystem supports multiple modes with smooth transitions
PerformanceMonitor tracks FPS and triggers quality adjustments
All GLSL shader files are valid and have proper uniform declarations
findings: All 71 tests pass (34 new tests: 22 for ParticleEmitter, 12 for PerformanceMonitor). TypeScript compiles without errors. Build succeeds. The PostProcessingStack uses inline shader definitions (vertexShader/fragmentShader strings) for the custom passes rather than importing the .glsl files directly, because ShaderPass expects JS shader objects with uniforms. The standalone .glsl files serve as reference implementations for the shader logic. GLSL module declarations in glsl.d.ts cover .glsl, .vert, and .frag extensions. The GPUParticleSystem uses window?.devicePixelRatio with optional chaining for testability in jsdom. Vitest ran in watch mode despite --run flag being passed via double-dash; tests completed successfully regardless.
